output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply and balanceOf[_owner] are both increased by mintedAmount without a check, allowing the owner to mint an arbitrary amount of tokens to any user account, causing a denial of service to the token buyer.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_from] -= _value; is executed with no check, allowing a user to cause an integer overflow in the balanceOf mapping, causing a denial of service to the token buyer.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value; is executed with no check, allowing an attacker to cause an integer overflow in the allowance mapping, causing a denial of service to the token buyer.
